messages.author: 4580988ac915524c
messages.subject: Installation glitch - No ANOVA no sign off message upon installation
parts:
Hi I am new to Lavaan and R. Using Ubuntu Linux14.04 and RCommander.
I can perform functions to provide fit measures, summaries of the fit of SEM models, but no ANOVA and on installation I got the message below:

[63] WARNING: 20 warnings.
First and last 5 warnings:
Installing package into '/home/ubuntu/R/x86_64-pc-
linux-gnu-library/3.3'
(as 'lib' is unspecified)
trying URL 'https://muug.ca/mirror/cran/src/contrib/lavaan_0.5-20.tar.gz'
Content type 'unknown' length 384055 bytes (375 KB)
==================================================
. . .
downloaded 375 KB
The downloaded source packages are in
'/tmp/RtmpfPnNh8/downloaded_packages'

Note the message doesn't say 
This is lavaan 0.5-13
lavaan is BETA software! Please report any bugs.


I suspect the problem may be that I haven't directed the Lavaan files to the right directory. How might I do so or can someone please assist in figuring this out.

Thanks, R

That looks fine. It has installed lavaan_0.5-20

Close everything and start a fresh R session.

> Note the message doesn't say
>
> |This is lavaan 0.5-13 lavaan is BETA software! Please report any bugs.|

Next step is to type

library(lavaan)

then, you should see the mesage:

This is lavaan 0.5-20
lavaan is BETA software! Please report any bugs.

If you still have issues, show us exactly what you do, and what is
printed on the screen.

Yves.
